html:
Click on the goddess (Sci-Hub’s founder, Alexandra Elbakyan) and you can see her CV.

It’s the most candid CV I’ve ever seen. Highlights:

2014: dropped out of graduate school;

2015: Sci-Hub sued in the US;

2016: Russian citizenship refused;

2019: master’s degree completed, but against many obstacles; labeled a Russian spy by US authorities

Political views: communist…
